identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Study of MRG003 Injection Combined With Pucotenlimab Injection ± Cisplatin Injection in the Neoadjuvant Treatment Locally Advanced EGFR-positive Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study of MRG003 Injection Combined With Pucotenlimab Injection ± Cisplatin Injection in the Neoadjuvant Treatment Locally Advanced EGFR-positive Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A Randomized, Phase II Study of MRG003 in Combination With Pucotenlimab Injection ± Cisplatin in Patients With Locally Advanced EGFR-positive Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma. This proposed study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of preoperative administration of MRG003 in Combination With Pucotenlimab Injection ± Cisplatin in HNSCC who are eligible for resection.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: In this study, eligible patients will be randomized in a 1:1 ratio to either the MRG003 Injection Combined With Pucotenlimab Injection treatment group (Cohort 1), or the MRG003 Injection Combined With Pucotenlimab Injection + Cisplatin treatment group (Cohort 2). Pathological response rate will be the primary outcome measures. Adverse events will also be recorded.

conditions: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma (HNSCC)

armGroups.label: MRG003+Pucotenlimab
armGroups.description:
Neoadjuvant:

Patients receive MRG003 in combination with Pucotenlimab for 3 cycles before surgery.

Surgery:

Within a 2-6 week window post induction, tumor imaging will be followed by surgical resection.

Adjuvant:

Patients receive adjuvant Pucotenlimab for 8 cycles.

armGroups.label: MRG003+Pucotenlimab+Cisplatin
armGroups.description:
Neoadjuvant:

Patients receive MRG003 in combination with Pucotenlimab + cisplatin for 3 cycles before surgery.

Surgery:

Within a 2-6 week window post induction, tumor imaging will be followed by surgical resection.

Adjuvant:

Patients receive adjuvant Pucotenlimab for 8 cycles.

interventions.name: MRG003 combined with Pucotenlimab
interventions.description: Both interventions all drugs intravenous infusion, D1, once every 3 weeks, a total of 3 cycles.

interventions.name: MRG003 combined with Pucotenlimab+Cisplatin
interventions.description: All interventions all drugs intravenous infusion, once every 3 weeks, a total of 3 cycles.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: After surgery (approximately 9-10 weeks after start of study treatment)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of patients with Adverse Events (AEs)
secondaryOutcomes.description: 79/5000 The incidence, severity and correlation of adverse events (AE), serious adverse events (SAE), immune-related adverse events (irAE), and laboratory index outliers were determined according to NCI-CTCAE v5.0 standards

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of surgery-related AE/SAE (adverse events/serious adverse events)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Rate of delayed or canceled surgery, length of surgery, length of hospital stay, method of surgery, and incidence of surgery-related AE/SAE (adverse events/serious adverse events) within 90 days after surgery

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of reduction in clinical stage after treatment
secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of clinical stage reduction after combination therapy in the target study population
